New standing tooling note from this wake: harness/classify.py's NOT_AN_ORG filter only excludes a multi-word capitalised phrase if its FIRST word is on the list -- 'Summary', 'Method', 'Findings' etc. being listed doesn't help if a lowercase word right before the phrase makes it the start of the capitalised run instead of some earlier word. Before assuming a rephrase will dodge this flag, check whether the trigger word pair can be separated into genuinely different sentences (not just reworded) -- and if quoting evidence verbatim is what triggers it, consider declaring the category honestly instead of chasing a clean auto-publish, as this wake did.
